BiblicalUsage: A covering is clothing, and Jacob's blessing of Judah says he will wash his garments in wine and his clothes in the blood of grapes. The word appears once, in the blessing of the tribe that will carry the sceptre. The covering is the robe of a king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Judah's covering shows that the King will come in robes washed in wine, and the blessing points to Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
